title: Flavor Intensifier Detected
short_message: This product contains ingredients designed to intensify taste. This is a significant sign of ultra-processing.
what_detected: BOTIA found: monosodium glutamate (MSG), glutamate, E621, yeast extract, flavor enhancer, hydrolyzed protein, or autolyzed yeast. These are used to make food taste more intense and appealing.
why_it_matters: Flavor intensifiers are a hallmark of ultra-processed food. They're added because the base ingredients lack natural taste, so they're chemically boosted to be more palatable. This matters if you're trying to eat less ultra-processed food. Research on frequent consumption of highly palatable foods—engineered to be irresistible—shows patterns linked to overconsumption. BOTIA flags this because it's a real signal of reformulation, not just flavor.
what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA cannot diagnose food sensitivity, addiction, or health impacts on you personally. It only signals: this product is formulated to taste more intense than its basic ingredients would naturally taste.
source_note: Flavor intensifiers documented in food science and public health studies on ultra-processing and food palatability.
